vulnerability.name: USN-8398-2
vulnerability.description: USN-8398-1 fixed a vulnerability in nginx. The update introduced a regression causing nginx to crash when being used with external modules. This update reverts the fix for CVE-2026-49975 pending further investigation.  We apologize for the inconvenience.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that nginx incorrectly handled certain cookie headers in  the HTTP/2 implementation. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue  to cause nginx to consume excessive resources, resulting in a denial of  service.

statements.status_notes: USN-8398-1 introduced a regression in nginx
